as_told.title: Ransone brings Gordon Cooper to Lab Nine

plain: The astronaut Gordon Cooper is said to have visited a lab run by a researcher named Puharich in Ossining, New York, during the 1970s. The researcher Greg Malatzi says Cooper went "many times" and wrote about it in his own book. According to Malatzi, Cooper describes seeing experiments with a Faraday cage, a metal enclosure that blocks electrical signals, and meeting the "space kids." An unnamed researcher guest on the same episode adds that a woman named Valerie Ransone brought Cooper there, in the late 1970s. The story matters to the tellers because it puts a famous astronaut inside a lab doing unusual contact experiments.
